steps.title: Safespot him by: — Going south, …
steps.text: Safespot him by: — Going south, to the tile east of the skeleton on the southern wall. — Going one tile north to step under him — If he paths south, walk one tile west for the safespot, otherwise repeat.

steps.title: Maximising damage on Count Draynor: with …
steps.text: Maximising damage on Count Draynor: with garlic in inventory, your first attack will deal 10 additional damage and lower his stats. The count also has a 6x health regen rate. — The garlic effect only triggers on punches or auto-casts, and will not trigger if only manual casting in the safespot. It also only deals the 10 damage if the Count is at full health. — A consistent way to work with this is to turn off auto-retaliate before the fight, use the staff to autocast and start attacking only after the safespot is set up completely. — Otherwise, punch draynor once immediately and make sure not to drop any ticks manual casting while setting up the safespot, only healing if absolutely necessary.
